comparison: Q01–Q06 application changes in working tree vs HEAD f48e99a; earlier guide-only edits retained separately
mode: manual source tracing with Graphify full local AST refresh
traversal: Bounded two dependency levels on manual audio/job publication, discovery/catalogue, craft-context consumers and shared shell/agent APIs; not an exhaustive repository call graph. Tests are evidence, not measured branch coverage.
limitations: Caller census incomplete; caller_count is null, adding 0.10 to upper bounds.
test_gap=0 means focused/static test-reference evidence exists, not complete runtime or branch coverage.
GPU/provider execution, production media acceptance and full application regression suite were not run.
Global discovery requires explicit provider-root environment configuration; no global installation/settings edited.
SQLite mode=ro can update volatile WAL shared-memory read-lock bookkeeping; persistent records/manifests/jobs were byte-checked unchanged.

Graph import-only neighbors ace_studio.py, projects.py, storyboard.py and vibe_editor_api.py were inspected as module candidates; their imported contracts remain unchanged. Two inferred test callbacks from stage_assets are not confirmed behavioral callers.

overall_risk.meaning: Heuristic boundary-impact priority, not a defect probability.
